text:
Alex H: hey all 👋 I'm Alex, backend eng. First day — my Okta flow shows 'Passkey not set up' and I haven't received the 1Password invite yet. Also need SSH/GitHub access for repo redwood/core. Who should I ping?
OnboardBot: Welcome Alex! I've created an IT ticket for account provisioning (#4712). IT will follow up here. If you have immediate blockers, add details and ETA expectations.
Kia (IT): hey Alex, cc'ing IT Ops. Quick checklist: 1) Check 1Password invite in your personal email + spam. 2) For Okta passkeys, you need to enroll via Settings > Security on dev laptop (device-trust). 3) SSH to GitHub — we usually have new hires generate an SSH key and upload to GitHub; you can store the private key in 1Password when seat is provisioned.
Alex H: thanks — invite not in spam. my laptop is an M2 macbook, not enrolled in Jamf yet.
Jamie L: FYI, GitHub doesn't support WebAuthn passkeys for git over SSH/CLI right now. For browser auth passkeys work for the web UI, but for CLI/SSH you need an SSH key (ed25519 recommended).
Kia (IT): Alex, workaround: run:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "alex@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub  # paste to GitHub settings > SSH keys
```
Once 1Password invite arrives, please store both private key and any passkeys there.
IT Ops: Assigned ticket #4712 to @Kia; we'll push a 1Password seat and GitHub repo access (redwood/core) by EOD tomorrow. If you need earlier access, reply with a public key and we'll add it manually.
Alex H: sharing pubkey now — pasted to the ticket. thanks!
Kia (IT): Got it, provisioning now. Also, once Jamf enrolls your device, Okta passkey enrollment should appear under "Device > Security" in Okta. Let us know if you hit the Okta enrollment loop.
Alex H: invite just arrived, redeemed 1Password, saved the SSH key there. browser passkey login works, GitHub push via ssh also working. thanks everyone :tada:
IT Ops: closing loop here — ticket #4712 updated. Reach out if anything else pops up.
